topics.description: The investigation into welfare fraud in Minnesota is intensifying, with Gov. Tim Walz announcing he won't seek a third term. The probe has led to a freeze on child care funding for 5 Democratic states.
topics.reason: High-profile investigation and potential funding freeze

topics.topic: Trump Administration's Freeze on Social Services Funds
topics.description: The Trump administration's plan to freeze social services funds in Democrat-led states has sparked controversy and concern among advocates.
